register: Stress tests over 60 additional sampled realizations beyond the 24-realization census: assignment = uniform-random equal-as-possible 10-group split (random.Random(2000+i) block-label shuffle, same family as the census urand draws, fresh seeds); ordering = uniform-random permutation of the stage-1 reconciled kept list (random.Random(3000+i)), so the random-permutation input-ordering axis, unsampled by the census's 4 structured orders, is sampled here. Scope: the 44 flip-driving measure-splits touched by the 15 exact contracts' delta_intervals; all other measure-splits held at published stars (their deltas were 0 for these contracts in all 24 census realizations, not re-verified under the new realizations). Clustering inputs K-table vintages (2024/2025 original, 2026 current), stage-1 reconciled membership (cost+d60r+emp), baseline operative published record (2024 recalc, 2025/2026 current), arms ward_tie vs dp with identical groups, outlier trimming, guardrails and display rounding, exactly as enclosure_census.py. Still not a proof over all realizations of SURVEYSELECT GROUPS=10 x input order: a breaker remains possible at the next unsampled realization.
assignment_rng: random.Random(2000+i) shuffle of size-quota block labels
ordering_rng: random.Random(3000+i) permutation of reconciled kept list
